resources.string: Tap the button to start the game!

Welcome to the "Number Showdown" game! 
 In this game, you will be going head-to-head with me using numbers! 
 
 You can see my number right from the start! 
 Press the button to randomly generate your own number. 
 If you think your number will be higher than mine, press "High." 
 If you think it will be lower, press "Low"! 
 
 WIN, and the screen turns red (+2 points). 
 LOSE, and the screen turns blue (-1 point). 
 DRAW, and the screen turns gray (+1 point)! 
 
 So, do you think you can beat me?
